sections.overall: The best matches of the week were The Young Bucks (again!) vs another iteration of The Rascalz (Reed & Wentz) (7.89, on Collision), and Will Ospreay vs Hechicero (7.83,  on Dynamite). The latter moved up 9 places to #24. Will he crack the top 10 with more regular performances? As Darby Allin's and MJF's match was under 5 minutes, this did not count in the ratings. Will they have a rematch at or before Double or Nothing? And, if they do, will it boost both up?
sections.mens: Notable by their absence are Adam Page (was #3) and Mark Briscoe (was #12). Both have been out of action since Revolution... who knows when either will return but here's hoping it is soon! No other major changes this week. Kevin Knight defended his TNT title against Claudio Castagnoli, but as both are already highly rated wrestlers (in the low 120s), the match did not affect either wrestler's rating much. 10 dropped out of the Men's rankings this week, which is why there have been a lot of gains, especially at the lower end of the rankings
sections.womens: For the first time and very likely not the last, Thekla sits atop the Women's rankings! So she is both the Women's champion and top rated women's wrestler now. Kris Statlander has only had squash tags with Hikaru Shida lately, so needs a counting match to re-enter the division now. Despite her poorly rated match against Kamille (3.83, re-entering at the bottom of the division), Willow Nightingale gains two places to #3, which is due to both Toni Storm and Statlander dropping out. That's right: since Revolution, Toni Storm's 'injury' has her out of the rankings for first time since 2024. Will she return soon?
sections.menstag: Other than another strong Bucks match, there isn't anything much else to note this week, other than The Swirl making a re-entry to the rankings, as part of the tandem being involved in the Trios match on Collision.
sections.trios: Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong have now entered the Trios division at the bottom; it will take more than their Collision match (rated 6.79) to progress up the Trios rankings. Had they had a better match against The Dogs at the recent Dynasty event, then they would likely be higher.  ProtOkada & Davis dropping out from #2 is the major change.
